# Tier B crates and their release confirmations (I-74, R-CR-02, ADR-001
# "Release gate" and amendment A5, M3 design section 2.6).
# Checked by tools/deps-check. A development build reports a shipped Tier B
# version without a confirmation and passes. `deps-check --release` fails.
#
# Format, one entry per line:
#   tier-b <crate>
#   confirmed <crate> <version> <source hash> <YYYY-MM-DD> <findings reference>
# The marker lines name exactly the crates of the ADR-001 Tier B table.
# The confirmation rows mirror the ADR-001 release gate table row for row.
# The source hash of a crates.io package is the .crate SHA-256 that
# deps/allowlist.txt pins. For a git package it is the full commit id of
# its allowlist source string (ADR-001 A3).
# No confirmation is recorded in M3.
tier-b moduletto
tier-b der
tier-b spki
tier-b x509-cert
tier-b cms
